name: Detección de Anomalías HOG
description: Analiza gradiente orientation distribucións using Histogram of Oriented Gradients. AI images exhibit more uniform gradiente orientations than natural scenes.
algorithm: Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) + Entropy Analysis
mechanism: Computes gradiente magnitudes and orientations, bins them into 9 bins. Higher entropía indicates more uniform distribución typical of AI.
parameters: Bins: 9, Orientation: unsigned [0,PI], Metric: normalized entropía
useCase: Detección de orientaciones de gradiente uniformes en contenido generado por IA

references.title: Dalal, N. & Triggs, B. (2005). Histograms of Oriented Gradients for Human Detection. CVPR.
Felzenszwalb, P.F. et al. (2010). Object Detection with Part-Based Models. IEEE TPAMI.
Lyu, S. & Farid, H. (2005). How Realistic is Photorealistic? IEEE TSP.

strengths:
• Captures local shape and gradiente structure effectively
• Well-proven in computer vision since 2005
• Detecta structural inconsistencias in generado por IA content
• Multi-scale orientation análisis
• Robust to iluminación changes due to gradiente normalization
limitations:
• Computacionalmente intensivo for dense extraction
• Cell and block size parameters affect sensibilidad
• Textured regions may produce noisy descriptors
• Limited effectiveness on smooth, característicaless regions
• AI models increasingly generate realistic gradiente structures
